title: Sichuan Buddha Fish Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic curry dish from the Sichuan region of India, made with fresh fish and a blend of warming spices.

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.notes: Fresh ginger is essential for this recipe

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic adds depth to the curry

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Sautéed onion adds a sweet flavor

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.notes: Diced tomato adds acidity to the curry

ingredients.name: Tomato puree
ingredients.notes: Thickens the curry and adds flavor

ingredients.name: Cumin powder
ingredients.notes: Ground cumin adds warmth to the curry

ingredients.name: Coriander powder
ingredients.notes: Ground coriander adds a citrusy flavor

instructions: Heat Buddha oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Add diced onion and sauté until translucent.
Add Sichuan pepper, cumin powder, and coriander powder. Sauté for 1 minute.
Add fish fillet and sauté until cooked through.
Add tomato puree, diced tomato, and enough water to cover the fish. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and serve hot with rice or roti.
